title: Scientific verification of psychological and pedagogical programs within the evidence-based approach paradigm: Implementation experience at MSUPE
abstract: Context and relevance. The professional community has varying understandings of the term “evidence-based approach” and, consequently, the criteria for assessing evidence. This article presents a developed at the Moscow State University of Psychology and Education (MSUPE) comprehensive operational algorithm for the scientific verification of psychological and pedagogical programs. This approach is relevant to the methodology of experimental randomized controlled trials. Objective. To identify the structural components of the operational algorithm for the scientific verification of psychological and pedagogical programs within the paradigm of the evidence-based approach, implemented at the section “Evidence-Based Approach in Psychology and Education” of the Scientific Expert Council of MSUPE. Hypothesis. Scientific verification, as an integral element of the evidence-based approach, promotes the dissemination of psychological and pedagogical programs with proven effectiveness. Methods and materials. The article employs general scientific methods of analysis, synthesis, and generalization, which were applied to the content of the regulatory framework relevant to the topic, scientific and methodological literature, and the regulation for the scientific verification of psychological and pedagogical programs within the paradigm of the evidence-based approach, developed and implemented at MSUPE. Results. The implementation of the regulation for scientific verification within the paradigm of the evidence-based approach ensures the development of an open registry of psychological and pedagogical programs with proven effectiveness, a registry of resource platforms, and a registry of scientific verification experts. Conclusions. The structural components of the current comprehensive operational algorithm for the scientific verification of psychological and pedagogical programs, developed at MSUPE, have been identified, namely: scientific-methodological, institutional, infrastructural-educational, and professional-sectoral. The organization of the scientific verification process for psychological and pedagogical programs, carried out in accordance with the requirements for their structure, content, and implementation outcomes, within an established infrastructure and interprofessional, organizational, and sectoral collaboration, ensures the dissemination of best practices within the paradigm of the evidence-based approach.
